newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle market quiet, no sales-private.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle market quiet, no sales-private.

text.p: Nebraska feedlot cattle bids at midday Monday were thin at $106.00 per cwt on a dressed basis and passed by owners asking $108.00 to $109.00, market sources said.
Owners also priced cattle at $68.00 on a live basis, but there were no reported bids.
Sales last week were mostly $106.00 to $107.00 in active trading. Live basis sales last week were mostly at $66.00, sources said.
This week's showlist was pegged near 83,900 head, down 1,400 from a week ago, the sources said.
